products.name: C2M Coherence Clusters, JMS Queues & Inbound Web Services (IWS) Configuration — Commercial
products.short_description: Configure the C2M runtime — Coherence clusters, JMS queues, and Inbound Web Services (IWS) — so the platform clusters, messages, and integrates correctly, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Wire up the C2M runtime: Coherence, JMS, and IWS

C2M's real-time behaviour lives in its runtime components — Coherence clusters, JMS queues, and Inbound Web Services (IWS) — and misconfiguring any of them breaks clustering, messaging, or integration. This solution configures the C2M runtime layer: Coherence cluster setup, JMS queues/topics and connection factories, and IWS deployment — so the platform clusters, messages, and integrates correctly, pilot-first.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M runtime: Coherence clustering, JMS messaging, and Inbound Web Services, and how they support batch, real-time, and integration.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (WebLogic domain, C2M product config, network/ports for Coherence, IWS prerequisites).
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to configure the named Coherence cluster, create JMS queues/topics + connection factories, and deploy/enable IWS, then validate clustering, messaging, and web-service calls, pilot-first.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (cluster formed, JMS flowing, IWS responding) plus Best Practices for Coherence/JMS/IWS.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The C2M runtime wired correctly — Coherence clustering, JMS messaging, and IWS integration all healthy — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MRUNTIME-Discovery.py — read-only snapshot of the C2M runtime (Coherence, JMS, IWS)
    • OC2MRUNTIME-Remediation.py — create/repair missing C2M runtime objects (DRY-RUN by default)
    • OC2MRUNTIME-Report.py — read-only health/coverage report for the C2M runtime
    • OC2MRUNTIME-ScopeHelper.sh — resolve and export the C2M runtime target scope for the other scripts
    • OC2MRUNTIME-Validation.py — read-only pass/fail checks for the C2M runtime

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
